column1: # Globals the two shipped addons read by bare name that this source tree does not
# Lua file, reads the GETGLOBAL instructions out of the bytecode and requires
# each name to be Lua 5.1, defined here, or reviewed below: a new unresolved
# name fails the gate until someone adds a row, and a row nothing reads any
# Kind: api, namespace, frame and constant are Blizzard surfaces; luaenv is a
# Lua library name the client publishes as a global; thirdparty is another
# addon's global MSUF probes; defect marks a read that is a bug, reported and
# deliberately not fixed here; vestigial marks a read of a global this tree
# stopped defining, kept because every read of it is guarded.
